capabilities: Render a Markdown note as a slide deck in a side panel
Export slides to PDF or a numbered PNG series
Flag slides that overflow the legibility floor
Apply built-in or user CSS themes per deck
Generate deck content from a note through an LLM endpoint
extras: Deck generation sends note content to a configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint (local by default, Anthropic if the endpoint manager supplies Claude); secrets are replaced by placeholders on the way out and API keys live in Obsidian's secret storage. On mobile, PDF export writes a self-contained HTML file instead of a PDF.
problem: Notes have no fixed-size slide view that looks the same regardless of vault theme, warns when text shrinks below a legibility floor, or exports straight to PDF and images.

relations.evidence: If the LLM Endpoint Manager plugin is installed, the endpoints (and their keys) come from it instead

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (e.g. LM Studio, Ollama)

summary: Renders a Markdown note as a themed slide deck in a side panel and exports it to PDF or a numbered PNG series, flagging slides that overflow.
